anchors.description: Long horizontal edge of the left floral bed pillow propped at the head of the bed.
anchors.visible_evidence: Left and right outer edges of the left floral pillow are crisp and unobstructed at mid-height; the pillow leans against the back wall above the maroon duvet.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact pillow size class unknown: standard 20x26 in (0.66 m) vs queen 20x30 in (0.76 m); stuffing puffiness adds a few cm to the seam-to-seam width.

anchors.description: Long horizontal edge of the right floral bed pillow, matching the left pillow in pattern and apparent size.
anchors.visible_evidence: The right pillow's inner seam (touching the left pillow) and its right outer edge are both visible at mid-height, well above the duvet line.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same size ambiguity as the left pillow (20x26 vs 20x30 in); the pillow is tilted back, but the 3D edge length is unaffected by foreshortening.
